title: Testamentary Trustee Nomination
text: I nominate {{ fiduciaries.testamentary_trustee.primary.full_name | name }}{% if fiduciaries.testamentary_trustee.co_primary.full_name %} and {{ fiduciaries.testamentary_trustee.co_primary.full_name | name }}{% endif %} to serve as Trustee of any trust created under this Will. {% if fiduciaries.testamentary_trustee.co_primary.full_name %}{% if fiduciaries.testamentary_trustee.co_trustees_action == "unanimous" %}If both nominated Trustees are serving, they shall act unanimously with respect to trust matters.{% else %}If more than one nominated Trustee is serving, the Trustees shall act by majority decision with respect to trust matters.{% endif %} {% endif %}{% if fiduciaries.testamentary_trustee.successor.full_name %}If no nominated Trustee is willing and able to serve, I nominate {{ fiduciaries.testamentary_trustee.successor.full_name | name }} to serve as successor Trustee.{% endif %}
